summary.text: Saint Basil the Elder was the husband of Saint Emilia and father of Saint Basil the Great. He was a lawyer and teacher of rhetoric at Caesarea.

blocks.text: The OCA distinguishes the father Basil from his better-known son. His family lived in Caesarea and held property near the Iris River in Pontus. The family maintained its Christian faith during persecution.

blocks.text: He and Saint Emilia had ten children. He supervised the first stages of his son’s education before Saint Basil the Great continued his studies elsewhere. Several of their children are commemorated as Saints.
